title: Noise Models Impacts and Mitigation Strategies in Photonic Quantum Machine Learning
authors: A. M. A. S. D. Alagiyawanna
summary: Photonic Quantum Machine Learning (PQML) is an emerging method to implement scalable, energy-efficient quantum information processing by combining photonic quantum computing technologies with machine learning techniques. The features of photonic technologies offer several benefits: room-temperature operation; fast (low delay) processing of signals; and the possibility of representing computations in high-dimensional (Hilbert) spaces.
